negative_snippets:
Worst experience ever.
This hotel was booked for guests arriving from another state for a marriage, and the experience was extremely disappointing. At the time of check-in, the staff demanded upfront payment in front of the guests, which was highly unprofessional and made both the guests and myself very uncomfortable.
On top of that, the receptionist was very rude and disrespectful in behaviour. There was absolutely no sense of hospitality or courtesy — nothing you would expect from a place calling itself a hotel or a “traditional inn.”
Overall, very poor service and completely unsuitable for hosting guests, especially for important occasions like a wedding. I would not recommend this place to anyone.
